criteria: FDIC-insured institutions with total assets over $1 billion and at least $100 million of commercial real estate loans (construction and land development + multifamily + nonfarm nonresidential), ranked by the noncurrent (90+ days past due or nonaccrual) share of those loans.

fieldNotes.creToTotalAssets: Commercial real estate loans as a percent of total assets (ASSET).
fieldNotes.nonOwnerOccCreToRiskBasedCapital: Construction and land development + multifamily + non-owner-occupied nonfarm nonresidential loans (LNRECONS + LNREMULT + LNRENROT) as a percent of total risk-based capital (RBC); null when the bank reports no total risk-based capital figure (banks that elected the Community Bank Leverage Ratio framework do not).
fieldNotes.nonOwnerOccCreToEquity: The same loans as a percent of total equity capital (EQ), available for every bank.
fieldNotes.yearEarlier: The same bank's noncurrent share in the same quarter a year earlier, when it filed then.

source: FDIC BankFind Suite financial data (Call Reports), computed by CREdocket
